question: Does the smallest direct current-main Crown of the Hearth branch payload map the four decisive controlled states exactly and remain capture-identity-safe on fresh whole-run identities under the qualified runtime?

design.type: fail-fast deterministic branch witness and paired capture identity
design.branchLocation: CombatRules._win_combat at the exact current-main crownOfTheHearth predicate and effect
design.observation: One capture-gated payload is emitted for each completed-combat evaluation. It records branch-time ownership and Ember state, direct branch and proc execution, HP transition and the existing proc queue correspondence.
design.eventIdentity: fight is the zero-based whole-run fight identity supplied before _fight; event is the deterministic combat-queue index at the Crown predicate. procQueueEvent separately identifies the existing Crown proc when the branch executes.
design.pathIdentity: Both whole-run arms record the same node sequence, per-fight queue SHA-256 and intermediate RNG cursor. The complete row is compared after removing only captureHearth and hearthBranchEvents.
design.notCausal: No payoff or acquisition-priority factor is present. No V30 row, endpoint, policy, seed, anchor or fit is used.

identityCohort.freshness: A read-only pre-freeze search found zero matching policy-root or simulation-seed identities in the append-only ledger and existing protocols.
identityCohort.baseline: Exact current-main content at source c4130163c7fb8edd865c0adc95732aae03e1bad2.

gates.controlledMapping: All eight state-by-capture executions must equal the frozen expected gameplay, queue, RNG and payload dictionaries exactly.
gates.controlledCorrespondence: Capture-off emits zero payloads and capture-on emits exactly one payload for each of the four branch evaluations.
gates.wholeRunCorrespondence: Capture-off emits zero payloads. Capture-on emits exactly one uniquely identified payload for every won fight and none for a non-winning terminal fight.
gates.wholeRunPayload: Every payload must have the exact schema, branch predicate, requested input, HP arithmetic, proc execution and independent proc-queue correspondence.
gates.identity: After removing only captureHearth and hearthBranchEvents, every paired whole-run row, node path, fight path, queue hash, RNG, policy, result and reliability field must be exactly equal.
gates.reliability: Zero error or stall rows in both arms.

decisionRules.success: Every controlled mapping, zero-or-one correspondence, direct payload, whole-run core/path/RNG/policy/result/reliability identity and numeric cap is exact green.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze Gate 1 as identity-safe and preregister Gate 2 before any sentinel or causal row. Gate 1 does not authorise a payoff claim, candidate, held-out run or product mutation.
decisionRules.failure: Any schema, controlled mapping, correspondence, identity, reliability, source, runtime, ledger, process, row or wall-time check fails.
decisionRules.failureAuthority: Quarantine Hearth immediately and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. No whole-run causal row, telemetry repair, second witness or rescue is authorised.
decisionRules.noRetry: This is the single authorised Gate 1 attempt. Do not edit the protocol, cohort, expected mapping, source or runner after execution to obtain a different result.
